title: RUBENSLUCIANO
subtitle: Immersive Website
description:
An immersive digital platform showcasing craftsmanship and innovation.
A WebGL experiential website developed for Rubensluciano to present its expertise in footwear design, prototyping, and white-label production for leading fashion and luxury brands.
The platform integrates an AI assistant to guide users, explain services, and qualify leads through an interactive brand experience.
